headline: Day one: the platform's foundation is laid

items.title: Production network and Postgres database
items.detail: VPC, subnets and an RDS Postgres database, all in Terraform. The database password is generated once and kept only in Secrets Manager.

items.title: Unicommerce order sync, first version
items.detail: Orders from every Unicommerce channel start flowing into our own database.

items.title: Staging schema and app database user
items.detail: A separate schema and a least-privilege user for the pipelines.

items.title: Business data lands in the right schema
items.detail: Fixed a bug that wrote Unicommerce data to the wrong place.
